summary: Tested the new Boutique CART feature end-to-end on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x844). All cart flows work: add/hover reveal, quantity increment on repeat add, separate lines for different products, cart-indicator + nav-cart badge sync, localStorage persistence across navigation, cart page controls (qty +/-, remove, clear), empty-cart state, checkout (toast + clear + redirect to /boutique), and mobile-nav-cart in mobile menu. 19/19 assertions passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart feature (React Context + localStorage 'cdc_cart') is fully working. Boutique add-to-cart buttons are hidden until product-card hover — must hover product-card-{i} before clicking add-to-cart-{i}. cart-indicator on /boutique shows 'Panier (n)'. Checkout is intentionally demo-only (toast + clear cart + redirect). Prior iterations already validated the rest of the site.
